kids: Stroll a free path of holiday lights
Reserve a time to meet Santa
about: Woodland Lights is the Washington Township Recreation Department's holiday light festival, and 2026 marks its 35th anniversary.
The township describes it as a month long festival of lights, vignettes and winter whimsy that draws thousands of visitors each year.
It takes place at Countryside Park beside the RecPlex on Miamisburg-Centerville Road.
Open nights this season include November 27 to 29, December 4 to 6, December 11 to 13 and December 18 to 23.
Hours are 6 to 9 PM with the gate closing at 8:30 PM, and a lights only stretch follows from December 26 to 30.
Construction in the park changes the route this year, so the lights are free and guests follow an abbreviated path that starts near the Fitness Center on the east road.
New this year, Santa visits are booked by time slot through the township recreation registration system.
A Santa visit costs $10 per family, and large groups of more than six people may want to reserve two slots.
After registering, families receive an email with more details about their visit.
Weather closings are posted on the township website, which also has a nightly information page for trip planning.
The RecPlex phone number is 937-433-0130 for questions about hours or registration.
faq: What are the Woodland Lights dates in 2026?
